79862.subject: 💸 Bitcoin ETFs have massive week as US Treasury yields hit new highs
79862.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $83,037 (-2.2%) | **ETH** $2,666 (-1.7%) | **SOL** $119 (-4.5%)

* Bitget's CEO says attackers exploited a third-party [zero-day](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2104509451357368460) to steal about $380M — Bitget resumes withdrawals in phases starting [September 28](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2103700726342148351) after fixing the vulnerability and launches a [Recovery Bounty Program](https://x.com/Crypto_Briefing/status/2103494177837424710)

* US 30-year Treasury yield tops [5.50%](https://x.com/Hedgeye/status/2103489193607582149) for the first time since 2004

* SEC staff issues new [FAQs](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2103559231626428851) clarifying when crypto activities fall outside securities laws

* Scammers extract over [$2 million](https://x.com/coinbureau/status/2104445429060718828) through a fake GIWA bridge before its mainnet launch

* Analyst Wazz ties 53 Robinhood Chain token launches to one rug-pull operation that extracted [$18.43M](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2104258817303388401)

* Spot crypto ETFs draw about [$3.04 billion](https://cryptoslate.com/us-crypto-etfs-draw-over-3-billion-this-week-with-nearly-800-million-flowing-beyond-bitcoin/) in weekly inflows — Bitcoin ETFs post [$2.4 billion](https://x.com/scottmelker/status/2104375538580181413) in weekly inflows, the strongest since October 2025

* Ethena expands its USDe backing strategy into [bStocks](https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2103439410083574160) and equity perpetuals on Binance

* Circle and Tether freeze stablecoins tied to the [$351.6 million](https://x.com/Saanjana_Nikita/status/2103522607173964111) Bitget hack

———————————————————————————

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin slipped below $83K as the Iran standoff lifted oil and yields, yet record ETF inflows and Strategy's largest-ever stack show institutional conviction holding firm. 🛢️ Bitcoin Slips Below $83K as Iran Standoff Lifts Oil Bitcoin fell to roughly $82,600 on Monday, down about 2% in 24 hours, after President Trump rejected Iran's conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Brent crude pushed toward $108. With 10-year Treasury yields at their highest since 2007, altcoins took the brunt — ZEC dropped 7% and DOGE 5% — as traders brace for Wednesday's PCE and Friday's payrolls data. Read full story 🔓 Bitget Reopens BTC Withdrawals After $387.5M Hack Bitget restored Bitcoin withdrawals at 08:00 UTC today, four days after suspected North Korean hackers drained about $387.5 million from its hot and warm wallets. ETH follows on Sept. 29, USDT on Sept. 30 and remaining assets on Oct. 2; the exchange says the exploited vulnerability is fixed and user balances are covered by its protection fund. More details ⚖️ California Bans Public Officials From Issuing Memecoins Governor Gavin Newsom signed AB 2409 on Sunday, barring California state and local officials from issuing memecoins and blocking platforms from offering official-linked tokens to residents from Jan. 1, 2027. He paired it with SB 1208, extending money-laundering laws to digital assets and expanding seizure powers, and openly framed the package as a rebuke of Trump's crypto ventures. Read more 🏦 Bitcoin ETFs Log $2.4B Week, Flipping 2026 Flows Positive U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs absorbed $2.4 billion in the week to Sept. 25 — the largest weekly haul since October 2025 — turning 2026 net flows positive at about $934 million after a $5.8 billion deficit in July. BlackRock's IBIT led with $1.2 billion, though daily inflows cooled from $999 million on Monday to $135 million by Friday. See details ☀️ Solana ETFs Post Record $188M Weekly Inflow U.S. spot Solana ETFs drew a record $188 million last week, with every fund posting inflows and Friday's $87 million marking the best day since launch. Bitwise's BSOL captured about $128 million, or 68% of the total, even as SOL trades near $119, roughly 60% below its all-time high. Bitcoin ETFs Just Turned Positive for the Year

US spot Bitcoin ETFs flipped to a year-to-date gain on
September 22 for the first time since May, erasing a deficit that
had bottomed near $5.8 billion in mid-July. A seven-day inflow
streak following the Treasury's bond buyback announcement added
roughly $3 billion.

BlackRock's IBIT alone brought in $1.2 billion during its
second-best week since October 2025.
